style: senior-friendly soft fruit memory game effects: warm, rounded, moderate volume, no harsh buzzer tones
designNotes: Moderate volume to reduce startle response.
Mostly 250-800Hz fundamentals with only light harmonics for clarity.
Rounded attacks and short tails so sounds feel gentle and do not clutter the game.
Incorrect-answer cue is supportive rather than punitive.

files.description: Gentle wooden pop: cute, short, low-stress, without sharp high frequencies.
Soft two-step toggle cue with a rounded switch feeling.
Clear but gentle countdown tick, easy to notice without startling.
Warm three-note start cue that feels inviting and unhurried.
Positive soft chime, encouraging without being loud or piercing.
Kind prompt sound that suggests another try, not failure.
Low supportive cue with no buzzer quality, designed to avoid discouragement.
Gentle completion flourish with a warm, celebratory but calm finish.
